decisions.reason: The Article 13 category mapping does not change author-name, author-photo, identity-matching, source, or placement requirements.
Assigning Article 13 to Politics does not change the required shape or size of author photos.
The category assignment for a different article does not alter the Dorian Vale article's color restriction or the reservation of red for the cover.
The message supplies category metadata for Article 13 but does not change the required source of article content.
The Article 13 category mapping has no effect on the issue's edition, month, or date metadata.
The message identifies Article 13's category and title but does not modify the publication's visual style or brand alignment.
The article-category mapping does not change the digital flipbook PDF deliverable.
The message contains no image-quality instruction and does not alter the existing conditional enhancement requirement.
The Article 13 category assignment neither changes the deferred print-ready deliverable nor resumes it.
